name: Water Body Survey
abstract: A survey of a water body: a SOSA observation feature with a custom survey result and a PROV provenance trace.

examples.title: Lake Geneva survey
examples.content: A short survey of Lake Geneva, with just the depth as its result.

examples.title: Full survey of Lake Geneva
examples.content: A complete survey, with all the result values and its provenance trace.

annotatedSchema:
title: Water Body Survey
description: A survey of a water body, as an observation feature with a custom result
  and provenance
allOf:
- $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/ogcapi-sosa/build/annotated/sosa/features/observation/schema.yaml
- $ref: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblock-prov-schema/build/annotated/ogc-utils/prov-entity/schema.yaml
- type: object
  properties:
    properties:
      type: object
      properties:
        hasFeatureOfInterest:
          $ref: https://opengeospatial.github.io/bblocks/annotated-schemas/ogc-utils/iri-or-curie/schema.yaml
        hasResult:
          $ref: https://avillar.github.io/bblocks-deep-dives-hands-on/build/annotated/deepdive/waterBodySurveyResult/schema.yaml
      required:
      - resultTime
      - hasFeatureOfInterest
      - observedProperty
      - hasResult
